title: Automated Blast-Radius & Projected Impact Analysis for Multi-Agent Worktree Concurrency
target_platform: macOS / Python 3.11+ / Git Worktrees & Coordination Flight Board
hypothesis: Augmenting mission manifests with native 'projected_impact' declarations and extending manage_coordination.py with an automated overlap matrix enables the flight board to automatically acquire exact target leases, surface disjoint parallel dispatches to incoming agents, and eliminate 100% of concurrent worktree merge conflicts without manual target path configuration.
falsification_criteria: An agent is able to check out a mission that silently conflicts with an active lease, manual --targets are still required at CLI checkout for registered missions, or collision detection overhead exceeds 500ms.
baseline_evidence: MISSION-026 established decentralized optimistic file leases and the flight board; however, target paths currently require manual agent declaration at checkout, introducing risk of under-locking or coarse-locking during parallel dispatches.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Escalate to frontier model only if cross-repository AST import graph traversal is required.
